decisionContract: equivalent means semantically interchangeable; no-match means the closest Solar evidence changes the object, action, state, or specificity.

entries.note: Solar video-frame-replace is a video-specific replacement action, not a generic replace control.
Solar ruble is the same Russian-ruble currency symbol.
Solar diskette is the conventional interchangeable save action.
Solar scale depicts a weighing device, not the balance-scale justice symbol.
Solar eye-scan expresses the same eye-scanning action.
Solar scanner is a device silhouette and does not preserve the scan-line action.
Solar settings is the same generic settings gear.
Solar shield-minimalistic is the same generic shield object.
Solar shield lacks the target's half-filled protection state.
Solar minimize-square-2 is the same shrink/minimize action.
Solar signpost is the same directional signpost object.
Solar signpost-2 is the same larger directional signpost concept.
Solar password encodes a password field, not a generic square-asterisk symbol.
Solar chart-square has bars but not the Gantt timeline structure.
Solar pen-new-square is the same edit-in-square action.
Solar sale-square is the same percentage-in-square symbol.
Solar three-squares is the same stacked-squares object.
Solar medal-star-square adds a medal/badge context absent from the plain square-star target.
Solar stop is a standalone stop button and does not preserve the square-stop construction.
Solar programming is the same terminal-in-square symbol.
Solar sticker-square is a sticker/faces object, not a document sticky note.
Solar tram is the same tram vehicle object.
Solar delivery is a hand truck/dolly and not a road truck.
Solar TV is the same television object.
Solar text-square-2 is the same typography/type control.
Solar umbrella is the same umbrella object.
Solar user-check is the same verified-user state.
Solar user-minus is the same remove-user action.
Solar user-plus is the same add-user action.
Solar user-check-rounded is the same rounded verified-user state.
Solar user-minus-rounded is the same rounded remove-user action.
Solar user-plus-rounded is the same rounded add-user action.
Solar people-nearby adds a location/nearby context and is not generic users.
Solar text-selection is a text-editing selection box, not a vector-square tool.
Solar smartphone-vibration adds a phone device, while the target is generic vibration.
Solar muted expresses the same audio-muted state.
Solar wallpaper is the same image-background object.
